correctness.rationale: The sphere equation Q(x)=sum x_i^2 mod3 is exactly support weight mod3. Conditioning one/two coordinates yields correlations g,h by N_e(j); swapping opposite coordinate characters yields d antisymmetric eigenvalues 1-g, d-1 symmetric-contrast eigenvalues 1+g-2h, and a 2x2 remaining block. For even d, j=0 gives two-level spectrum, exact comparison with j=1,2; odd d radius-one eigenvalue extrema have R=sqrt(8d+1), and supplied positive cross-products establish strict j=1 optimum. Independently constructed every complex character Gram matrix at d=4..8 and checked all spectra and strict optima including unique d=4,2 singularity; tests corroborate and are not used as all-d proof.
